minor.issue: Duplicate-name check uses slugify(name) so 'Blog posts' (slug 'blog-posts') is allowed when a default 'Blog posts' with hard-coded slug 'blog' already exists. Uniqueness should key on normalized name OR default collections should be inserted with slugify('Blog posts')='blog-posts' to be consistent.

action_items: Optional: unify duplicate-collection detection to compare on normalized name (or seed default collections with slugified slugs) so POSTing 'Blog posts' twice returns 400 regardless of default slug (line cms.py:109).
critical_code_review_comments: cms.py:109 duplicate check only uses slug not name — hard-coded default slugs ('blog','case-studies') don't collide with slugify(name) of same display name, so client can silently create a second 'Blog posts' collection with slug 'blog-posts'.

cms.py public_collections is called inline in the public site payload but its items query has .to_list(200) with no pagination indicator; large blogs will silently truncate. Consider adding a .count field.
cms.py extract_text for PDFs swallows any exception into a generic HTTPException(400,'Could not read this PDF') — logs would help diagnose corrupted uploads.
cms.py brief_upload reads entire file into memory with no size cap — a 50MB pdf will be fully loaded before rejection. Add UploadFile size check.

cms.py install_template inserts workflows with runs=0/last_run=None but does not de-duplicate: calling POST /apps/{id}/workflows/templates/change_request twice yields two identical workflows firing on every event; UI already installs 3 defaults on app create so a user re-adding change_request via /portal fire path will trigger multiple change_request workflows on the SAME app for one request. Consider idempotency by (app_id, template) key.

server.py new-app create flow: install_defaults is not shown in the request flow — verify defaults are installed only once (not on every GET); pytest confirmed 3 defaults appear on newly created app but no dedupe guard exists.

portal.py leads count uses source in ['contact','chat'] — chat_lead workflow triggers on source='chat' but sample uses different key names. Not blocking but naming is inconsistent between messages.source and workflow trigger sample keys.
Portal: portal-request-row rendered client-side but portal-live-link only shows when preview_enabled — safe, but there is no fallback text for offline apps (empty column looks broken).
